race.comment: DIAMOND SHOW (2) has been knocking on the door of another victory with three consecutive runner-up finishes and this is not an overly strong affair. Gets 3kg off from the inside marble and should be right there at the business end. SARAH'S SONNETS (8) is a very consistent conveyance who has only missed a drum once in seven career outings. Sure to run her usual honest race and worth including. O'CALDINO (12) has placed over this staying journey. Gets in well at the weights and looks one for the exotics players. CAST PARTY (7) broke the maiden five back and has been racing well of late. Last start was beaten 1.4 lengths when third over 1800m at Eagle Farm. Key runner.
